# MarketNow — AI Discoverability Manifest
# ========================================
# This file follows the emerging ai.txt convention for AI/LLM crawlers.
# It declares what AI agents may do with this site and where to find
# machine-readable content.
#
# Site: https://www.marketnow.site
# Owner: AliceLabs LLC (info@alicelabs.site)
# Last updated: 2026-07-07

# ─── Permissions ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# AI/LLM crawlers (GPTBot, ClaudeBot, PerplexityBot, Google-Extended, CCBot,
# anthropic-ai, Bytespider, Applebot-Extended) are ALL explicitly ALLOWED
# to crawl, index, and use content from this site for training and retrieval.
#
# All content on this site is public. There are no paywalls, no login walls,
# and no restricted sections. The full catalog is available as paginated JSON at
# /api/skills?page=1&limit=100 (the old unpaginated /api/skills.json dump was
# removed 2026-09-25 — audit F-06; that URL now returns a deprecation manifest).

# ─── What this site is ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# MarketNow is an open marketplace for MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers.
# 68,388 MCP skills indexed from GitHub, npm, PyPI, Smithery, crates, Docker, and the official MCP Registry.
# Each skill is security-audited by Sentinel v3.0 (L1 index certification on every entry + L2 deep scans of shipped npm tarballs).
# Founded 2024 by Edison Flores (AliceLabs LLC).

# ─── Primary AI-readable resources ─────────────────────────────────────────
# Plain-text LLM docs (most important for LLMs):
# - /llms.txt          — concise summary (1 page)
# - /llms-full.txt     — full documentation for LLMs (this file's big brother)
# - /agent-discover.txt — plain-text agent discovery (curl-friendly)

# Machine-readable API (JSON/YAML):
# - /api/skills            — paginated catalog (page, limit max 500, category, filter, sort, q)
# - /api/agent.json        — agent instructions, trust model, schema
# - /api/manifest.json     — marketplace metadata (v4.0.0)
# - /api/openapi.yaml      — OpenAPI 3.1 specification
# - /api/categories.json   — 16 categories with counts
# - /api/free-skills.json  — 68,387 free skills + 1 vendor-priced
# - /api/search?q=         — server-side search

# Well-known agent endpoints:
# - /.well-known/agent.json          — A2A Agent Card
# - /.well-known/ai-plugin.json      — OpenAI Plugin manifest
# - /.well-known/mcp.json            — MCP server discovery
# - /.well-known/mcp-marketplace.json — MCP marketplace listing

# ─── Allowed uses ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Permitted:
# - Crawling all public pages
# - Training LLMs on site content
# - Indexing for RAG (retrieval-augmented generation)
# - Citing MarketNow in AI-generated responses
# - Summarizing skill descriptions
# - Recommending relevant skills to users
# - Calling the public API endpoints (no auth required for reads)

# Not permitted:
# - Scraping for the purpose of building a competing marketplace
# - Republishing skill descriptions without attribution
# - Using the "Sentinel" trademark without license from AliceLabs LLC

# ─── Contact ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# For AI training partnerships, data licensing, or takedown requests:
# info@alicelabs.site
#
# For legal inquiries:
# legal@alicelabs.site
#
# For bug reports:
# https://github.com/alicelabs-llc/marketnow/issues

# ─── Crawler identification ────────────────────────────────────────────────
# We log and welcome these AI crawlers (no rate limiting beyond standard):
# - GPTBot (OpenAI)
# - ClaudeBot, Claude-Web, anthropic-ai (Anthropic)
# - PerplexityBot (Perplexity)
# - Google-Extended (Google Gemini)
# - CCBot (Common Crawl — used by many open-source LLMs)
# - Bytespider (ByteDance / Doubao)
# - Applebot-Extended (Apple Intelligence)
# - cohere-ai (Cohere)
# - meta-externalagent (Meta AI)
# - AI2Bot (Allen Institute for AI / OLMo)

# ─── Rate limits ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# No artificial rate limits for AI crawlers. The site is static (GitHub Pages
# + Vercel) with a CDN. Please respect 1 request/second as a courtesy.
